findings.comment: Transformer pads show no written Austin Energy Design approval for any clearance reductions. No documentation provided verifying conditions for 3-foot clearance exception (confinement status, window separation, fire rating, or AE Design written approval).

Transformer pad access door sides and orientations not depicted on plan. Cannot verify 10-foot hot-stick use area clearance to open area or adjacent structures without identifying access door orientation.

Transformer pads are not identified on landscape plan. Cannot verify that trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution are utility-compatible species, or cross-reference with ECM Appendix F 'UC' column.

Transformer pads are not identified on landscape plan. Cannot verify shrub or low-lying vegetation clearances (10 feet from access door side, 5 feet from other sides) without transformer locations and access door orientation shown.

Transformer pads are not identified on landscape plan. Cannot verify required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) for trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment.

No cross-section drawings provided showing vertical clearances from transformer locations to overhead structures, parking garages, enclosed areas, or niche configurations demonstrating required clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: East central transformer pad location between Building 4 and Building 5
findings.comment: Grading plan contours show drainage flowing from transformer pad location toward Building 5 (east). Oil-filled transformer equipment requires liquid flow to be directed away from buildings; this configuration directs flow toward Building 5 foundation, creating fire and contamination hazard.
Transformer easement boundaries, widths, and accessibility requirements are not shown on electrical plan. Cannot verify easement adequacy for Austin Energy accessibility requirements.

No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided. Pad dimensions, construction details, and specifications for specified service type (single-phase or three-phase) cannot be verified against AE Design standards.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations adjacent to parking or vehicle routes
findings.comment: No bollard details or protective barrier specifications shown for transformers located within 4 feet of parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes. Required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts per AE Design equipment pad details are not depicted.
